The flake's dev shell has the toolchain the README builds with: the
      # pinned nightly with wasm32, and the nixpkgs `dx`, which wraps the
      # wasm-bindgen-cli that bbtree/vis/Cargo.toml pins.

A name that matches no test, say after a rename, would drop that
      # test from Miri without a word.

`--cfg tsan` has the optimistic reads of a latched tree tell TSan to
      # ignore them: they race with writers on purpose, and a version check
      # after throws away what they read (`src/tree/node/optimistic.rs`).
      # TSan checks every other access. It exits with an error after any
      # report.

`-Zbuild-std` instruments std as well, which needs an explicit
      # `--target`. Doc tests aren't built with the sanitizer, so they stay
      # out.
